args.requirement: The Icon Detail modal must have aria-pressed states on toggle buttons (Favorites button and variant pills) and a visually hidden aria-live region to announce copy actions.
args.checkContents:
#!/bin/bash
# Check that the icon-detail.tsx file has the required accessibility attributes

FILE="src/components/icons/icon-detail.tsx"

# Count occurrences of aria-pressed (should be at least 2: one for favorite button, one for variant pills)
aria_pressed_count=$(grep -c 'aria-pressed' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
if [ "$aria_pressed_count" -lt 2 ]; then
  echo "FAIL: Expected at least 2 aria-pressed attributes, found $aria_pressed_count"
  exit 1
fi

# Check for the live region with sr-only, role="status", and aria-live="polite"
if ! grep -q 'sr-only' "$FILE"; then
  echo "FAIL: Missing sr-only class for visually hidden live region"
  exit 1
fi

if ! grep -q 'role="status"' "$FILE"; then
  echo "FAIL: Missing role=status on live region"
  exit 1
fi

if ! grep -q 'aria-live="polite"' "$FILE"; then
  echo "FAIL: Missing aria-live=polite on live region"
  exit 1
fi

# Verify the favorite button has aria-pressed with isFavorite binding
if ! grep -q 'aria-pressed={isFavorite}' "$FILE"; then
  echo "FAIL: Favorite button missing aria-pressed={isFavorite}"
  exit 1
fi

# Verify variant pills have aria-pressed
if ! grep -q 'aria-pressed={activeVariant === key}' "$FILE"; then
  echo "FAIL: Variant pills missing aria-pressed={activeVariant === key}"
  exit 1
fi

echo "PASS: All required accessibility attributes are present"
exit 0
